actual_action: The video starts with a still image of a man holding a large travel bag and walking out of a hotel. The scene then animates: the man completes his exit from a revolving door, turns around on the sidewalk, and walks back into the same revolving door.

artifacts_with_times.description: During the man's turn, the travel bag's silhouette distorts unnaturally. The canvas body appears to compress and warp in a way that doesn't correspond to physical motion or gravity.
The man's turn is abrupt and jerky, lacking fluid, natural motion.
The man's gait as he walks away from the camera is stiff and unnatural.
As the man enters the revolving door, his left leg and the corner of the bag appear to momentarily clip through the solid base of the door frame.

limitations: The analysis is purely visual. Video resolution may obscure extremely subtle artifacts. Assessment of motion naturalness is subjective but based on common physical principles.
